description: The original adult human female peasant: fair skin, ordinary serious face, long thick wavy dark brown hair swept behind her shoulders down to mid-back, small plain gold earrings. Dark forest green fitted bodice with fine tan-gold front and back cross lacing, short green upper sleeves over white linen puffed elbow-length sleeves, broad white gathered square neckline. Long flowing green overskirt open down the lower front over a white linen underskirt, white hem and black low shoes. A dark brown leather waist belt with small brass buckle holds a narrow sheathed dagger at the hip. Both hands are empty.
